scope: Workflow candidate and frozen context contracts
schema_source: Current runtime DTOs and candidate validator output schemas.

workflows.selection: Selected authorized Source/Bronze Objects supply evidence. Output Entity identities include a configured Logical schema. Mapping and Code belong to modeled Entities.
Selected Logical Entities and their Attributes supply direct lineage. Output Entity identities include a configured Dimensional schema. Physical registration is independent export configuration.
Selected authorized Source/Bronze Objects supply evidence. The Model revision fences the frozen authoring context.
One schema-qualified modeled Entity/System pair. Physical evidence feeds Logical Mapping; eligible peer Logical/Dimensional entities provide planned lookup schemas without registration.
Applied Entity-owned Mapping supplies the Code input. Planned target coordinates use Model GDS placement and the Entity schema/name. Artifacts are owned by that Entity.
Validation remains Model/System-owned. It consumes Mapping and Code for schema-qualified modeled Entities.

checks: Returned Object key exists in the initial authorized scope/index.
Returned Attribute key exists under its stated Object in the initial authorized scope/index.
Complete from-Attribute key and parent Object exist in the initial authorized scope/index.
Complete to-Attribute key and parent Object exist in the initial authorized scope/index.
No duplicate relationship identities: Model + from key + to key + relationship kind.
Values match the actual Pydantic/database contract, including confidence values and distinct endpoints.
workflows.generation_policy: Previously approved high-confidence-only authoring; separate from the stored confidence enum.
schema_notes: relationship_kind and relationship_basis are nonblank text; kind is not an enum.
Status and lock are backend-owned; inference cannot author them.

checks: Selected Object/Attribute keys exist in authorized scope.
Batch configuration is valid for every selected Object.
Measurement targets are complete and unique.
Counts, lengths, and percentages satisfy existing metric rules.
workflows.failure_behavior: All-or-nothing saving; no model correction loop.

shared_checks: Server-derived Tenant/Model ownership and source authorization.
Frozen Workflow Run selection and Model revision fencing.
Bounded JSON, canonical natural-key identity and normalized duplicates.
Configured schema membership and complete same-Model typed references.
Preserve retained history, locked records, omission-is-not-delete, and idempotency.
entity_ownership: Mapping and Code reference Logical/Dimensional Entities directly. Dimensional lineage references Logical Entities/Attributes. Physical registration remains an independent export step.
